items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of influent screening and grit removal; biological removal of biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and nitrogen in aerobic, anoxic, and pre -anoxic basins; microfiltration through a membrane bioreactor (MBR); ultraviolet (UV) light disinfection; and return activated sludge pumping from the MBR back to the aeration basins.

Waste activated sludge pumping removes excessive biomass from the system, followed by a proprietary sludge digestion process, dewatering via centrifuge, and disposal to a Class II I solid waste landfill.
